visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized title card featuring large yellow and blue text against a light blue gradient background. Small icons and branding are visible in the upper corners. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor medical clinic setting. A male doctor in a white coat sits at a desk, a female nurse stands behind him, and an elderly man with gray hair and a dark jacket sits across from them, clutching his chest in apparent pain. A younger man in a yellow hoodie sits beside him, looking concerned. (3) The nurse hands a small cup of clear liquid to the elderly man. He drinks it, and his facial expression shifts from a pained grimace to a look of sudden relief and contentment. (4) The camera cuts to a medium shot of the doctor and the young man in the yellow hoodie talking privately. The background is a white wall with medical posters. (5) An elderly woman with gray hair, wearing a patterned red shirt, is now the patient. She points to her eyes and face while talking to the doctor. The doctor uses a small device to inspect her ear area. (6) The elderly woman smiles and looks relieved after the doctor's interaction. The scene ends back with the doctor and the young man talking in the private shot.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-tempo, bouncy synthesizer beat begins immediately, establishing a comedic tone. A male voice lets out an exaggerated, strained groan of pain, followed by a series of rapid Mandarin dialogue exchanges. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect punctuates the transition as the music continues steadily. A younger male voice speaks quickly and apologetically, followed by the doctor's calm, reassuring vocal delivery. (3) A new phase is triggered by a digital 'pop' sound effect as a graphical overlay appears. The elderly woman begins speaking in a higher-pitched, slightly distressed tone, which is quickly met by the doctor's steady, rhythmic explanation. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This comedic sketch satirizes the dependency of some elderly people on 'medicine' or doctor's visits, revealing that the miraculous cures are often just vitamins (placebo) or simple attention from medical staff. It uses high-energy editing and exaggerated performances characteristic of the 'TGOP' (這群人) style to entertain a social media audience.
